name: govuk-frontend-example-go
description: Go line of the GDS-compliant GOV.UK Frontend template. Server-rendered HTML from Go (native component renderers); Node only for govuk-frontend pin, Sass, and shared baseline tests; no SPA UI frameworks.

scripts.verify:docs: npm run format:check && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:go: go vet ./... && go fix -diff ./... && go tool staticcheck ./...
scripts.audit:npm: node --test tests/audit-npm.test.mjs && node scripts/audit-npm.mjs && npm audit signatures && node scripts/check-npm-lockfile.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:baseline && npm run test:styles && npm run build:styles && npm run test:go
scripts.verify: npm run verify:docs && npm run audit:npm && npm run build:styles && npm run lint:go && npm test
